proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove a small group-suffixed helper family for first-occurrence/list insertion, dllseg split/join, sentinel exclusion, and owned-field address inequality. Use it first to decompose the input DLL into the asserted member/sentinel cut, then to rebuild each updated DLL, and finally instantiate the two public-contract derivation wands with identical post assertions after list rewriting.

Use existing xizi_dll_open, xizi_dll_close, xizi_dll_nonempty_rev, xizi_dllseg_unfold, list_snoc_destruct, store_ptr_undef_store_ptr, and store_4byte_valid.

proof_groups.grouping_reason: One bounded group is intentional: all seven witnesses are under the limit of twelve and depend on one tightly coupled DLL segment/list helper family. Splitting would either duplicate the sentinel-exclusion/list-append helpers or introduce an unnecessary shared-helper dependency.
